tasks.gr7-common-fractions-t2: Topic: Common fractions. Cover equivalent fractions, comparing and ordering, operations with fractions and mixed numbers, and fraction of quantity. Ask Grade 7 learners to simplify, calculate, and solve practical sharing and grouping contexts accurately.
tasks.gr7-decimal-fractions-t2: Topic: Decimal fractions. Cover place value, comparison, ordering, and all four operations with decimals. Ask Grade 7 learners to calculate in money and measurement contexts and identify common decimal alignment and rounding errors.
tasks.gr7-functions-and-relationships-t2: Topic: Functions and relationships. Cover input-output rules, tables, inverse thinking, and number sentences. Ask Grade 7 learners to identify rules, find missing values, and explain relationships between input and output clearly.
tasks.gr7-area-and-perimeter-of-2d-shapes-t2: Topic: Area and perimeter of 2D shapes. Cover formulas for rectangles and squares, perimeter-area differences, and composite shape decomposition. Ask Grade 7 learners to choose correct formulas, apply units correctly, and solve contextual geometry problems.
tasks.gr7-surface-area-and-volume-of-3d-object: Topic: Surface area and volume of 3D objects. Cover nets, prisms, cubes, surface area, and volume calculations. Ask Grade 7 learners to interpret nets, classify solids, and calculate using correct square and cubic units.
